fixture_mutations: The +6 dB fixture changes only the signed OpusHead Q7.8 output-gain field and recomputes the first Ogg page CRC. The R128 fixture adds one OpusTags comment and recomputes that page CRC. The module validates all page CRCs, expected header/comment values, and equality of encoded audio pages before probing.

reference_decode.measurement: RMS after excluding the first and last 10 percent of decoded frames. Runtime acceptance windows are 1.92..2.07 for the +6 dB header gain and 0.97..1.03 for the tag-only comparison.

tag_reader_mutations: Synthetic OpusTags packet fixtures use valid Ogg page framing and CRC; duplicate fixtures preserve the same generated Opus audio packet page.
